title: Fix the Switch Fall-Through
description: The program should print the name of a day based on a number.
expectedBehavior: For day = 2, the program should print only 'Tuesday'.
actualProblem: None of the cases end with a break, so once execution matches case 2, it falls through and also runs the code for case 3 and default, printing three lines instead of one.
explanation: Without break, C's switch statement continues executing every subsequent case's code regardless of its label. Adding break after each case's logic stops this fall-through behavior.
